definition: A statistical model that predicts a continuous output as a weighted linear combination of input features.
details: Linear regression is one of the most fundamental algorithms in statistics and machine learning, forming the conceptual basis for understanding more complex regression and neural network models.

explainer.lead: Linear regression predicts a continuous output as a weighted linear combination of input features. It matters as one of the most fundamental algorithms in statistics and machine learning and the conceptual basis for more complex regression and neural network models.

tiers.eli5: You guess a number by multiplying each input by a weight, adding them up, and using that total as the prediction.
tiers.practitioner: Used as a baseline and building block for more complex models; a pitfall is relying on it when the relationship between inputs and output is not linear.
tiers.paperLevel: A statistical model predicting a continuous output as a weighted linear combination of input features.

explainer.example: Predicting a continuous outcome from input features by summing each feature times its weight.
